equivalence_basis: u-s01 was authored from this lesson and names L1.M2.03 as its only lesson_ref, and the lesson's extractable claims are already in the ledger as cl-001 (discipline split), cl-002 (every word from a core and template), cl-003 (core-sharing implies related meaning), cl-012 (vocabulary gloss as translation) and cl-015 (the initial م as template material). Relative to u-n07 the substance is not new in domain but the lesson supplies contrasts u-n07 does not carry: content interrogative of the naming class versus yes-no particle of the residual class, the coordinator meaning and read as coordination, circumstance or oath, and the plain versus geminated adversative with different governing behaviour. The prepositional and negator inventories themselves add nothing to u-n07 or u-n01.

Against u-s03 and u-s05 this lesson is redundant: its participle and place-noun rows restate their recognition criteria at introductory depth and add no condition. Against u-s01 it is not redundant, and the new material is exception-level rather than procedural: four-consonant cores, which u-s01's exceptions do not list alongside weak, geminate and connecting-hamza cases, and the explicit statement that many core-and-template combinations are unattested, which constrains any generative use of the ownership procedure. The placeholder notation itself is already implicit in u-s01's slot-mapping wording.

u-n01 already carries the case and mood system and holds fixed-ending words only as a single exception clause, and u-n09 covers positional and estimated case. What this lesson adds is the class-level inventory itself: an explicit, closed listing of which categories can bear a marker and which cannot, usable as a pre-filter before u-n01's marking-plus-governor procedure runs. Its rationale for the perfect stem and its two defective examples add nothing and should not be promoted.

u-n01 already holds the case and mood system with a stricter evidence rule, and u-s06 holds the weak and five-verb classes. What this lesson adds to u-n01 is a class-by-state availability matrix stated as a hard restriction, namely that the genitive is unavailable to verbs and the jussive to nouns, which u-n01 does not record and which functions as a cheap contradiction check on any proposed analysis. It adds to u-s06 the observation that the jussive of those classes is realised by letter deletion rather than by a vowel. Its numeral example is defective and must not be promoted.

every grammatical claim in this lesson is already carried by u-n02 and by the inna family block of inc-nawasikh, which already lists all six members with the correct signature; the lesson is therefore redundant on the governance axis, and its only genuine contribution is the modal discrimination among members plus the parallel enclitic paradigm, neither of which is executable by the pattern-consistency consumer because the particles are lexically distinct on the surface and need no disambiguation

a per-lexeme gender attribute carrying attested-variation marking, since no morphological analysis can supply gender for these nouns

equivalence_basis: the regime discrimination itself is already present in the repository: the negation increment carries functions for the past particle with a jussive, the future particle with a subjunctive, the prohibitive and declarative uses of the general negator, categorical negation, the perfect-negating particle with a perfect verb, and the negating verb in a nominal clause; the abrogator unit already places that verb in the كان family with a nominative subject and accusative predicate. What is not already present is its person, number and gender conjugation together with its lack of an imperfect, which is paradigm substance rather than regime substance

the existing negation increment already discriminates the two particles, but it consumes a declared mood feature for the following verb as an input; nothing in the repository derives that feature from a surface form, and deriving it is exactly what this lesson supplies

u-n05 already owns relative clauses and the returning pronoun as a topic, and no increment implements it yet; what this lesson adds is the complete form inventory with its agreement keys of gender, number and humanness, the dual case alternation, and the definiteness gate on the antecedent. The gate is expressible with the registered discriminator_table capability (features: head definiteness and clause completeness; outcomes: relative pronoun licensed, bare descriptive clause, or abstain) without any consumer change

u-n05 already owns the returning pronoun as a topic; what this lesson adds is the case-by-role rule, an explicit deletion licence with a single permitted configuration, and two hidden-realisation configurations (active subject and passive deputy subject). The deletion and hidden cases have exactly the shape the hidden-structure increment's licensing table already consumes, namely a construction mapped to a hidden element with an obligatoriness flag and an analysis-dependent note, so they can be added as rows with no consumer change

Not redundant. u-s06 lists weak classes one at a time and u-s07 states individual substitution and deletion rules; neither says what happens when two of those rules target one stem, which is the entire substance of this lesson. new_capability_required: an abstain-capable or multi-label discriminator output: the discriminator_table consumer expects one winning label per occurrence, but this distinction has no formal discriminator and must be able to return two attributed analyses without either being marked wrong
a counterfactuality or modality annotation interface; none of the capability families with a real consumer can carry the claim that the stated condition did not obtain

an information-structure interface covering topic, focus, and restriction; none of the capability families with a real consumer can carry a pragmatic-effect claim, so those claims would otherwise be dropped or silently recoded as syntax
a quotation-scope and speaker-frame interface; none of the capability families with a real consumer can represent which speaker a person reference is anchored to inside an embedded report

an interface for a case that is syntactically assigned but has no surface exponent (covert or deleted marking); none of the existing capability families can represent an exponent that is licensed yet unrealised

assignment of a case role to a token that bears no case exponent (the mahall relation); no existing capability family accepts case-without-exponent as an output, so the fixed-form analysis currently has no executable consumer
speaker-authority and addressee-uptake features are unavailable to any current consumer; the non-particle cases would need a pragmatic-context interface before any force label could be projected
addressee-knowledge-state modelling; no current consumer accepts a feature representing what the addressee already knows, which is the pivot of the entire lesson

an authority-asymmetry and discourse-stake feature would be needed before the directive, commitment and status-conferral readings could be projected; the invocation discriminator needs no new capability

equivalence_basis: Not marked redundant: the analytic content genuinely overlaps L5.M1.06 and L5.M1.07, but three things are not stated there — the production-direction transformation procedure, the register-based selection heuristic between the two devices, and the drafting templates for scope, exemption and liability clauses. What this lesson adds is method rather than new linguistic fact.
new_capability_required: a production/composition capability — generating or validating a learner-authored restricted proposition against an intended target element — has no consumer interface in tools/curriculum_unit_consumer.py

figurative-versus-literal adjudication interface: deciding that a token's literal reading is untenable needs world knowledge plus clause context, which no token-feature discriminator currently exposes

literal-possibility test interface: an adjudication step asking whether the surface reading is world-coherent, plus a slot for the cultural premise it depends on; no current unit consumer can express either

relation-typing interface for non-resemblance transfer, carrying a direction field per instance plus a slot recording that a case has a competing syntactic-ellipsis analysis; nothing in the current consumer set represents either

pragmatic addressee resolution: a way to record that the intended target of a syntactically generic expression is a specific discourse participant, with the situational evidence attached; no current unit consumer represents speech-act targets
effect attribution has no consumer interface: detection itself fits pattern_consistency over a span, so only the interpretive half of the lesson is unrepresentable and should be kept instructional

a boundary-scoped resolver that takes an ordered token pair plus a delivery mode and returns the realised vocalisation; all current unit interfaces are single-token and cannot express a rule whose domain is the junction

the template classifier must accept a fourth radical slot; every current interface in the catalogue is written against a three-slot root, so four-radical stems cannot be expressed at all rather than merely being expressed badly

licensing_table entries that can express a SET of licensed cases with a distinct analysis per member, plus a frequency/preference annotation; whether the existing licensing_table consumer accepts multi-valued outcomes was not verified here.

A ranked_parse_set interface: the ability to emit several licensed analyses for one span with a preference ordering, the principle that produced the ordering, and an explicit abstention when context does not select. The listed capability families all assume a single verdict per item.

A recursive clause-scope binder: given a sentence, return for every conditional particle occurrence its nesting depth and the exact span of the result it governs, and classify every فاء as result-marking, coordinating or resumptive. None of the existing capability families expose depth-indexed clause binding.
a span-anchored rhetorical annotation interface: every figure in this module is a relation over a span or a ranked sense list, and no registered capability accepts spans or sense inventories as input

a metrical scansion capability taking a pronounced-form syllable-weight string plus a candidate meter and returning match, licensed-variation match, or abstain; the registered pattern-consistency capability is specific to abrogator families and their two marked positions, so it cannot serve this input at all

an orthography-to-pronunciation normaliser producing a syllabified weight string; the module presupposes this layer throughout but the repository has no interface that accepts orthographic tokens and returns phonological syllables

a delivery-mode field on occurrence evidence: every case and mood consumer currently assumes the ending it is shown is the ending assigned, and nothing in the interface lets an analyser record that a token was delivered in pausal form and its ending is therefore unobserved rather than absent
a register-scope gate: no existing capability family lets a rule declare that it is active only in metrical verse, so licence rules cannot be safely projected over mixed or prose corpora
form-provenance flagging: a way to mark a surface form as attested in a cited line versus constructed for illustration, so licence-generated variants are never imported as lexical entries

register-scoped constraint relaxation: the consumer needs to express that adjacency is required in prose and relaxable in verse for an enumerated set of interposers, which no current capability family can represent
an elision-recoverability check: distinguishing an object omitted because it is recoverable from one withheld for effect requires discourse-level evidence that no current capability family supplies

equivalence_basis: The executable grammar in this lesson is the accusative assignment by the emphatic particle and the independent-versus-embedded distribution of the two particle forms, both of which are already carried by u-n02 and were stated more fully in L6.M3.02 within this same module. The remaining content is a register and audience model with no surface-checkable criterion and no consumer in the existing capability families, so it is recorded as instructional material rather than as unit substance.
new_capability_required: a register or formality label would require a situational-context interface supplying setting, audience and speaker relationship; none of the existing capability families accepts such input, and without it no consumer can act on the lesson central claim
register attribution on a text span - choosing between the two profiles requires knowing which dialectal register a text follows, and no current consumer carries a register field
an attribution channel on governance edges - the ability to carry two school-attributed justifications for a single exponent without either being marked resolved, preferred, or default

negative paradigm assertion - a way to record that a template-licensed cell must never be generated for a given lexeme; current consumers express what a pattern produces, not what it must refuse to produce
an informativeness adjudication interface - deciding whether a co-root accusative adds content is a semantic judgement, and no current consumer can supply, store, or check that judgement
multi-sense retention - a gloss channel that keeps two or more licensed senses for a single occurrence, each with its register condition, instead of ranking them or selecting one

passage-level register classification has no consumer among the implemented capability families, which all operate on a token or a template; a register-profile scorer over passages would have to exist before any of this material could be executable rather than instructional
a scripture-citation binding on parse records - claims keyed to a specific aya need a citation field, a reading-tradition field, and a two-vote gate; no current consumer carries any of the three

a convention field on a parse record - the same clause receives two defensible labellings depending on which comment-slot convention is in force, and no consumer can currently record which convention a stored parse follows
register and period tagging on a text span, plus a per-span flag for whether case is realised - several rules in this lesson are conditional on both, and no current consumer can express either
a term-alias layer over the label set - a commentary using non-standard or rival-school nomenclature cannot currently be matched to the unit that encodes the phenomenon it is describing

a provenance-and-layer field on any claim extracted from commentary prose - which layer it came from, which commentator, and whether the surrounding block was a quotation, a gloss, or an argued justification; no consumer can currently distinguish a commentator's assertion from the base text it quotes
